## Interpretation limits

PASS qualifies the viscous operator and the moving no-slip mirror wall for smooth wall-driven solenoidal shear at Ma ~ 2e-3 on a regular lattice with delta/dx >= 8, h/dx in [1.3, 1.9], H/delta = 6. It does not qualify free-surface, high-Ma, turbulent or pressure-gradient boundary-layer flow.

Reproduction: `PYTHONPATH=.:src python benchmarks/stokes_second/run.py --ladder --c0 4 --periods 6 --measure-periods 2 --out benchmarks/stokes_second/out`
